name: Whole-roasted celery root with coriander seed oil
intro: taste is even more wonderful than before. I like to eat it as it is as a starter, cut

ingredients.item: large celery root, hairy roots discarded (no need to trim) unpeeled but scrubbed clean (2½ lb/1.2kg)
olive oil, plus extra to serve
coriander seeds, lightly crushed flaked sea salt
lemon, cut into wedges, to serve

method: Pierce the celery root with a small sharp knife all over, about 20 times. Place the celery root in a baking dish and rub generously with the oil, coriander seeds, and 2 tsp flaked salt. Roast for 2½–3 hours, basting every 30 minutes until the celery root is soft all the way through and golden brown on the outside.
Cut into wedges and serve with a lemon wedge, a sprinkle of salt, and a drizzle of oil.
